title: DIDGE.ai Live at the DPR East Coast Regional Summit
summary: Presenting and live-demoing DIDGE.ai to DPR leaders from across the East Coast at their regional summit in Pennsylvania.
body_markdown:
For an audience of builders responsible for some of the most demanding projects on the East Coast, the conversation quickly turned practical: how continuous site digitization changes daily operations.[DIDGE.ai](http://didge.ai/) automatically documents every area of a project, tracks work-in-place for all trades, and flags safety and quality issues as they emerge - giving teams ground-truth facts to prevent costly mistakes before they happen, instead of reacting after the fact.


Thank you to DPR for the invitation and the great questions. **"Nice start, great start, fabulous"** - as the writing on their wall says - **"now the big question is: what's next?"** We can't wait to show you.
